svg.title: Get help
svg.desc: The two current Get help commands: offline Help and the About information window. Command guide illustration, not a screenshot. No live user data.
svg.metadata: Source: addin/LOKAL.PowerPoint/Ribbon/LokalRibbon.xml; addin/LOKAL.PowerPoint/Ribbon/LokalRibbon.cs; addin/LOKAL.PowerPoint/LOKAL.PowerPoint.csproj; assets/*.png. Help behavior checked against UI/ActivityOptionsHelpForm.cs and UI/AboutLokalForm.cs. Authored as a code-native SVG command guide. Existing PNG icons embedded without external image references. Commands using Office imageMso icons are represented by a plain Office label, not a substitute icon.
svg.text: Command guide · illustration, not a screenshot
Open the built-in Activity Options guide.
Read quiz settings and shared controls.
The guide works offline and can stay
open while you work in PowerPoint.
Get help is available whether you are signed in or signed out.
Based on current LOKAL commands. Layout is explanatory, not Office UI.
